title: Nine Trays of Noise
subtitle: 食堂与餐厅 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 食堂与餐厅（生活与学习·学校与校园）
meta: 主题语境：食堂与餐厅（生活与学习·学校与校园）　|　核心词汇：cafeteria　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 cafeteria 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1957 my mother was sent to run ① a cafeteria she could not enter, and she said the entering was the whole of the lesson. The ② cafeteria, meaning the hall and not the meal, was nine trays wide and was cleared by whoever came last; a cafeteria, she said, is the only thing in a school that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ cafeteria in that school had the same queue, and the ④ cafeteria at the back, meaning the one the cook kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever run properly. A cafeteria, my grandmother said, is nine parts noise and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the noise is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ cafeteria was the whole of the lunch, meaning the hour it filled and not the hall. The ⑥ cafeteria, meaning the lunch and not any of that, is the only thing in a school that everybody queues in and nobody questions; a cafeteria, he said, is either something you run or the only word that means both a hall and a lunch. She said the lunch is the part they remember.

By 1973 the ⑦ cafeteria had become a photograph in a report, and the report had become an argument about the queue. The ⑧ cafeteria of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine trays and eleven years of clearing; a cafeteria, she said, is either the one at the back or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ cafeteria I remember is the one at the back, which was rebuilt in 1978 and is still described as the best in the county. A ⑩ cafeteria, my grandmother said in 1983, is the only thing that improves by being queued in; every cafeteria, she said, is a lunch that has agreed to look like a hall. She said the lunch was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 食堂；自助餐厅
B. n. 食堂（指那个厅本身，与饭菜相对）
C. 固定搭配：run a cafeteria 经营／管理一个食堂
D. n. 食堂（指那所学校里每一个）
E. n. 食堂（指后面那一个）
F. n. 食堂（抽象：它填满的那顿午饭）
G. n. 那顿午饭（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: a cafeteria she could not enter
The cafeteria, meaning the hall and not the meal
cafeteria was the whole of the lunch
the cafeteria had become a photograph in a report
The cafeteria of the whole thing
A cafeteria, my grandmother said in 1983

answers.why: run a cafeteria 意为“经营／管理一个食堂”，1957 年母亲被派去管理一个她进不去的食堂。
cafeteria 意为“食堂”，指那个厅本身而不是饭菜，摆得下九个托盘，由最后走的人收拾。
cafeteria 指那所学校里每一个食堂，每一个都是同样的队伍。
cafeteria 指后面那一个（厨子管的那一个），是唯一有人认真经营过的。
cafeteria 意为“食堂”，抽象指它填满的那顿午饭，父亲说 cafeteria 就是那顿午饭的全部。
cafeteria 为抽象用法，指那顿午饭本身，是学校里人人都排队、却没人质疑的东西。
cafeteria 意为“食堂、自助餐厅”，到 1973 年这个 cafeteria 成了报告里的一张照片。
cafeteria 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九个托盘和十一年的收拾。
cafeteria 意为“食堂”，我记得的是后面那一个，1978 年重建，至今仍被说成全县最好的。
cafeteria 为抽象总称，祖母说食堂是唯一会因为有人排队而变好的地方。
